title: Fee Waiver Rules for Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Contracts
content:
A fee on a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract can be waived only while the contract status is active, assigned for repossession, repossessed or in deficiency. A fee transaction may be waived only once, and waivers are always of the whole fee transaction; partial waivers are not granted.

| Waiver reason | What it applies to | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| Courtesy for on-time history | a late charge only | the installments in a row without a late charge are at least the tier's courtesy minimum, and the courtesy waivers on the contract in the 12 calendar months ending today, inclusive, are below the tier's courtesy allowance; a tier whose allowance is 0 receives no courtesy waivers |
| Servicing error | any fee the company's own records show was caused by a company error, such as a payment posted late by Kestrel or an autopay draft taken on the wrong date | not limited in number |
| Bank error on a returned payment | a returned-payment fee | the customer's bank has confirmed in writing that the return was the bank's own error |

Repossession, transport, storage and condition-report expenses and extension fees are never courtesy-waived.

**Counting installments in a row.** The installments in a row are the installment due dates after the due date of the installment that carried the most recent late charge on the contract — or from the first payment date when there has been none — up to today.

### Points of judgement (hypothetical)

- On a tier allowing one courtesy waiver in 12 months after 9 installments in a row, a customer with 9 installments in a row and no courtesy waiver in the last 12 months may have a late charge courtesy-waived; with 8 installments in a row, not.
- A transport charge cannot be courtesy-waived on any tier.
- A late charge already waived once cannot be waived again, and half of a fee is never waived.
